analysis.title: Acuity Inc. (AYI): Announced acquisition of Parameter Technologies would add data center breadth; expected to be accretive
key_insights: AYI announced before market open on 10/26 a definitive agreement to acquire Parameter Technologies for $675mn, implying ~6.8x CY27E sales and ~16x CY27E EBITDA. Close is expected in F2Q27, subject to customary conditions including expiration of the HSR waiting period.

Parameter provides leak detection, battery monitoring and environmental monitoring for data center facilities, server rooms, cooling infrastructure and servers, through the RLE Technologies and CellWatch brands, with ~115 employees across the US and Europe. It will join Distech Controls within Acuity Intelligent Spaces (AIS).

Parameter expects ~$100mn of CY27 sales, up 30%+ yoy, at ~40% EBITDA margin, implying ~$40mn of CY27 EBITDA. GS estimates AYI's consolidated FY27E EBITDA margin at ~19.7% and gross margin at ~50.1%, so Parameter's gross margin is likely above the corporate average.
AYI did not discuss any potential cost synergies. AYI expects the deal to be accretive to FY27 adjusted diluted EPS and to AIS revenue growth and margins.

The deal would add sensing and location-specific leak detection to Distech's edge controls, building management software and cloud-based monitoring. Parameter's products cover liquid- and air-cooled data center environments at facility, server room, rack and server layers.

GS believes most of Parameter's ~$100mn CY27 revenue comes from data center applications, with further growth from penetration of the installed base. Management sees the deal rounding out Distech's data center offering after the introduction of PLC controls, supported by Parameter's hyperscaler and cooling equipment OEM relationships and Distech's system integrator channels.
Funding is $500mn of borrowings plus ~$175mn of balance sheet cash. AYI held ~$636mn of cash as of Aug 31, and GS says the deal implies some modest net cash.
GS rates AYI Neutral with a 12-month price target of $345, based on 15X P/E on Q5-Q8 EPS forecasts. The price was $318.72 at the 10/26 close, implying 8.2% upside.

market_movers.rationale: GS keeps its Neutral rating and $345 target (set 01-Oct-26) after the Parameter deal announcement. The target uses 15X P/E on Q5-Q8 EPS, implying 8.2% upside from $318.72.

earnings_insights: GS EPS forecasts (estimates, not reported): FY 8/26 $19.90, FY 8/27E $21.27, FY 8/28E $22.98, FY 8/29E $24.62.
GS quarterly EPS: 8/26 $5.77, 11/26E $5.05, 2/27E $4.17, 5/27E $5.78. Only the 8/26 figure is a past period, and the report does not say whether it is reported or adjusted.
AYI expects the Parameter deal to be accretive to FY27 adjusted diluted EPS. The company gave no cost synergies.
risk_factors: Stronger or weaker commercial end-market conditions.
Greater or lesser ability to capture price increases.
The deal is subject to customary closing conditions, including HSR waiting period expiration.
